startup_slash_s.negative_control: At a DOS prompt launch `SIMANT /s` followed immediately by Alt+209. MSC stdargv reads PSP:81h, skips only CR/NUL, blanks and tabs as delimiters, and copies D1 with LODSB/STOSB into argv[1][2]; _isdigit receives -47 and would read 79F0. This is not in launch arguments [].

renderer_contract.transition: one styleIdx++ in one if per loop iteration, before text[pos] is consumed
renderer_contract.rewind: end=brk; if end<start then start=end; pos=end; styleIdx is not rewound
renderer_contract.right_extension_bound: a transition inside skipped whitespace extends through its post-skip destination; the next style position is strictly beyond that destination, so the one-transition-per-iteration rule cannot delay a later transition
renderer_contract.initial_run: renderer starts at text offset 0; its first classified argument is conservatively bounded from 0
renderer_contract.final_run: no ctype call occurs after the last style transition; the final style has no outgoing transition
